steps.en: Officer opens the temporary suspension form for the chosen notices
steps.id: Officer membuka form suspensi sementara untuk notice yang dipilih

steps.en: Officer picks the suspension code from a drop-down list
steps.id: Officer memilih kode suspensi dari daftar drop-down

steps.en: The number of suspension days for that code appears
steps.id: Jumlah hari suspensi untuk kode itu muncul

steps.en: Choosing a code is required before the officer can continue
steps.id: Memilih kode wajib sebelum officer bisa lanjut
